rules.source_title: Fisheries and Marine Resources (Fishing of Octopus) Regulations 2016
rules.citation: GN No. 167 of 2016, reg. 2 and 4(a): 'undersized octopus' means any octopus which is less than 7 centimetres in mantle size
rules.scope_note: Not applicable to Rodrigues; scientific-research exemption exists (reg. 5).
rules.note: GN 167/2016 defines undersized octopus by MANTLE size (under 7 cm), not total length. The app records total length, so this rule cannot be decided from that measurement - measure the mantle and verify. Whether the regulation remains in force in 2026 is pending confirmation.
